props.name: seedlings
props.text: Seedlings planted in the field that were lost to mud.

props.name: muddy_soil
props.text: Black soil falling onto legs and body during relief.

sequences.name: Field Work & Urge
sequences.summary: Neena works in the field, feels an urge, and runs to the river.

scenes.name: rice_paddy_field
scenes.summary: Neena plants seedlings and experiences physical urges.

clips.name: Planting Seedlings
clips.action: Neena reaches down into the muddy water to plant her seedlings.

clips.name: Feeling Urge
clips.action: A sudden warmth in her stomach demands to be known as she bends her knees.

clips.name: Running to River
clips.action: She realized that she couldn't stay and ran toward the water, feet sinking into mud.

sequences.name: Relief & Realization
sequences.summary: Neena relieves herself on the river bank and realizes the mess made.

scenes.name: river_bank
scenes.summary: Neena squats to urinate and defecate, then feels the loss of innocence.

clips.name: Squatting to Urinate
clips.action: She lifted her saree and lowered her hips to the ground to urinate.

clips.name: Defecating in Mud
clips.action: She excreted, watching the black soil fall onto her bare legs and back.

clips.name: Realizing Spoilage
clips.action: She realized that the seedlings she had planted were gone, lost to the mud, just like the feces that coated her skin.

sequences.name: Cleansing at River
sequences.summary: Neena washes off and bathes in the river to feel clean again.

scenes.name: shallow_water
scenes.summary: Neena removes her cover completely and bathes in the cold water.

clips.name: Washing Saree Off
clips.action: She quickly went to wash the saree off at the edge of the water.

clips.name: Removing Cover Completely
clips.action: The moment the last thread touched the wet air, she removed her entire cover, stripping her saree to the waist and then naked.

clips.name: Full Body Bath
clips.action: Taking a full body bath in the river was her way of cleansing the earth as cold water rushed over her shoulders.
